adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(() => { ... })` without any `.catch(...)`. Unlike `save()` (which does `.catch(popupAjaxError)`), a failed DELETE would not surface an error to the admin and would result in an unhandled promise rejection; the UI also won’t remove the row because removal is only done in the `then` path via `deleteHost`.
